verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU. It has no product UI whose actions could be mirrored by an API, so API/UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The oneAPI/OpenVINO developer tooling and the intel.com llms.txt/OpenAPI probes are about software libraries and the corporate website, not a UI-equivalent API for the processor, so they do not make the axis applicable.
